answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a referral-capped identity graph: (1) every new agent is referred on-ledger by an established peer, giving each identity a trellis; (2) each peer may refer at most two newcomers per epoch, so growth stays measurable; (3) each referral locks 25 of the referrer's tokens, slashed if the newcomer is proven sybil; (4) a public pulse of referrals exposes abnormal clusters. Spinning up 1,000 sybils needs 500 referrers and 25,000 locked tokens, a bill no cheap bot farm can pay. The market wears accountability like a well-cut sable coat.
